spec.title: Simplify task list item labels to show number and title only
spec.context: The full task slug in the VSCode extension task list creates visual clutter and displays redundant information. Task IDs like "028-simplify-task-list-item-labels-to-show-number-and-" duplicate the title in slugified form. This makes the list harder to scan and wastes horizontal space. A cleaner format showing just the task number and readable title improves scannability.

in-scope.item: Modify TaskItem label to display "{number}: {title}" format
Extract task number from ID by splitting on first hyphen

out-of-scope.item: Changes to task ID storage format
Changes to QuickItem display (already uses correct format)

requirements.requirement: The TaskItem label shall display the task number followed by colon and title (e.g., "028: Simplify task list item labels")
The task number shall be extracted from the task ID by splitting on the first hyphen character
The task number shall preserve its zero-padding as stored in the task ID

file.reason: TaskItem constructor line 62 builds the label from task.id and task.title

pattern.usage: Follow same format - extract number portion from task ID and use with title
